title: Peak Season Survival Guide: Stocking, Shipping & Planning Ahead
titleCn: 旺季生存指南：备货、发货与提前规划
desc: Emma和James聊Q4旺季备货的那些事：最晚下单时间怎么算、安全库存留多少合适、运费暴涨怎么办、如何引导客户做明年的滚动预测。全是实战经验，新人必听。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: Welcome back to TradeTalk! I'm Emma, and today we're talking about the most stressful time of year for trade professionals — peak season.
lines.cn: 欢迎回到TradeTalk！我是Emma，今天我们聊外贸人一年中最紧张的时期——旺季。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: Oh, peak season. The time when every buyer suddenly remembers they need stock for Black Friday and Christmas, and they all want it delivered yesterday.
lines.cn: 哦，旺季。就是每个买家突然想起他们需要为黑五和圣诞备货，而且都希望昨天就到货的时候。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: Exactly! James, you've been through quite a few peak seasons. What's the number one mistake new sellers make?
lines.cn: 没错！James，你经历过不少旺季了。新人最常犯的错误是什么？

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: The biggest mistake is promising unrealistic lead times. A new seller gets an inquiry and says 'sure, we can deliver in 20 days' just to get the order. But during peak season, production takes 35-45 days, plus shipping. Then they miss the deadline, the buyer loses sales during the biggest shopping event of the year, and that buyer never comes back.
lines.cn: 最大的错误是承诺不切实际的交货周期。新人收到询盘，为了拿单就说'当然，我们20天就能交货'。但旺季生产需要35-45天，还要加上运输时间。然后他们错过了截止日期，买家在一年中最大的购物活动中损失了销售额，那个买家再也不会回来了。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: That's a great point. So what should sellers do instead?
lines.cn: 说得好。那卖家应该怎么做呢？

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: Be specific and proactive. Instead of saying 'we can deliver quickly', calculate the exact latest order date. For example: 'Today is September 4th. With our 35-day production lead time and 10-day ocean transit, if you place your order by September 15th, we can guarantee delivery by October 30th — a full month before Black Friday.' This shows you're professional, you understand their business, and you're giving them a concrete deadline to work with.
lines.cn: 要具体且主动。不要说'我们可以快速交货'，而是计算准确的最晚下单日期。比如：'今天是9月4日。我们35天的生产周期加上10天的海运，如果您在9月15日前下单，我们可以保证10月30日前到货——比黑五早整整一个月。'这显示你很专业，理解他们的业务，而且给了他们一个具体的截止日期。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: Love that. Now, what about order quantity? Buyers always struggle with how much to order — too little and they stock out, too much and they're stuck with inventory after Christmas.
lines.cn: 很喜欢。那么订单数量呢？买家总是纠结订多少——订少了缺货，订多了圣诞节后积压库存。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: This is where you can really add value as a supplier. Don't just say 'order whatever you want'. Help them calculate based on data. If they sold 40,000 pieces last year and their store traffic is up 20%, a reasonable forecast would be 48,000 pieces. Then add a 15-20% safety stock, so 55,000-58,000 pieces. And here's the key — offer a flexible solution. Say: 'Order 50,000 now for the main season, and if you need more in November, we can do a quick reorder of 10,000 pieces with a 20-day rush production.' This reduces their risk and gives them confidence to order more.
lines.cn: 这正是你作为供应商可以真正增加价值的地方。不要只说'随便订'。帮他们基于数据计算。如果他们去年卖了4万支，店铺流量增长了20%，合理的预测是4.8万支。然后加上15-20%的安全库存，就是5.5-5.8万支。关键是——提供灵活的方案。说：'现在先订5万支应对主旺季，如果11月需要更多，我们可以做1万支的快速补货，20天加急生产。'这降低了他们的风险，让他们有信心多订。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: Brilliant. Now let's talk about the elephant in the room — freight rates. Every year during peak season, freight rates go crazy. How do you handle that with buyers?
lines.cn: 太棒了。现在我们来谈房间里的大象——运费。每年旺季运费都疯涨。你怎么跟买家处理这个问题？

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: First, don't hide it. Be transparent. Say: 'Freight rates have increased 25-30% since August due to peak season demand and limited vessel space.' Then, give them options. Option one: ship early by October 5th to lock in current rates before the next increase. Option two: switch from full container to less than container load, which reduces upfront cost by 15% but adds 5 days transit. Option three: combine this order with next quarter's forecast into one 40-foot container, reducing per-unit freight by 22%. The key is to give choices, not just bad news.
lines.cn: 首先，不要隐瞒。要透明。说：'由于旺季需求和舱位有限，自8月以来运费上涨了25-30%。'然后给他们选项。方案一：10月5日前提前发货，在下一轮涨价前锁定当前价格。方案二：从整柜改为拼柜，减少15%的前期成本，但运输时间增加5天。方案三：将这个订单与下季度的预测合并成一个40尺柜，单位运费减少22%。关键是给选择，而不只是坏消息。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: That's such a good approach. Now, looking beyond Q4 — how do you get buyers to plan for next year? Most buyers just order when they need stock.
lines.cn: 这个方法太好了。现在，展望Q4之后——你怎么让买家为明年做计划？大多数买家只是需要库存时才下单。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: This is the holy grail of account management — getting buyers on a rolling forecast. But you can't just say 'give me your forecast'. You have to make it easy and show the value. Propose a flexible arrangement: 'You don't need to commit to firm orders for the whole year. Just share a tentative 6-month forecast. In return, we'll reserve production capacity for you during peak months, lock in raw material prices now, and offer a 5% annual volume rebate.' Then, offer to help them build the forecast. Say: 'I can prepare a simple Excel template based on your 2026 sales data. We can review it together in a 15-minute call next week.' Make it easy for them to say yes.
lines.cn: 这是客户管理的圣杯——让买家做滚动预测。但你不能只说'给我你的预测'。你要让它变得简单并展示价值。提议一个灵活的安排：'您不需要承诺全年的确认订单。只需分享一个暂定的6个月预测。作为回报，我们会在旺季月份为您预留产能，现在锁定原材料价格，并提供5%的年度数量返利。'然后，主动提出帮他们做预测。说：'我可以根据您2026年的销售数据准备一个简单的Excel模板。我们可以下周花15分钟通话一起回顾。'让他们容易说同意。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: That's brilliant, James. So to summarize: be specific with lead times, help buyers calculate order quantities with data, give options for freight challenges, and make forecasting easy and valuable.
lines.cn: 太棒了，James。总结一下：交货周期要具体，用数据帮买家计算订单数量，运费问题给选项，让预测变得简单且有价值。

lines.speaker: james
lines.en: Exactly! Peak season doesn't have to be stressful. With good planning, clear communication, and proactive solutions, you can turn peak season from a nightmare into your best sales quarter. And remember — the buyers who survive peak season with your help will remember you and come back year after year.
lines.cn: 没错！旺季不一定是压力山大的。有了好的规划、清晰的沟通和主动的解决方案，你可以把旺季从噩梦变成你最好的销售季度。记住——在旺季得到你帮助的买家会记住你，年复一年地回来。

lines.speaker: emma
lines.en: Perfect. Thanks for sharing your wisdom, James. And thanks to all our listeners — go out there and conquer peak season! We'll see you next time on TradeTalk!
lines.cn: 完美。感谢分享你的智慧，James。感谢所有听众——去征服旺季吧！我们下期TradeTalk再见！
